journal_time._merge_note: Round zero is the BUILD and is not a review round (docs/AAA-STANDARD.md, 'Round zero is the build'). Written to scratchpad rather than docs/aaa-scorecard.json because eight other 4t agents share that file.

evidence.fidelity: SYS-16's eight kinds and CAST-05's two-ledger rule taken from docs/spec/SYSTEMS.md 362-371 and docs/spec/PEOPLE.md 710; every derived number is INV-760..765; the brooch tell is read out of npc/faction.py rather than restated; route times come through transit.walk_leg
evidence.robustness: station/journal.py --selftest is 32/32 with eight negative controls that fire (a fact with no source, an unlisted kind, an actor row with nobody in it, an incident with no cid, a favour with no cause, standing with no cause, a stored fid contradicting its own fields, a route time transit.py contradicts); station/journal.py --gate is PASS with three controls that FAIL as required

what_is_good: the acceptance is two Godot PROCESSES -- learn, quit, reload -- which is strictly stronger than coldstart.py --g8's in-process restore
the fact id is FNV-1a checked across the Python/GDScript boundary at load, and journal.gd REFUSES to mint on a mismatch
time compression is discriminated from a jump by the only accumulating state in the build, because life.gd's Director is pure in the hour by design
journal.gd is instantiated by main.gd::_start_journal on the shipped _ready path and appears in save.gd::_subjects, not under a gate flag

findings.text: There is no journal SURFACE. SUR-09 asks for a diegetic identicard-adjacent screen; the journal has entries() and prints them to stdout, and a player in the build cannot open it. It reads as a data store rather than as a thing in the world.

The witness loop is O(days x calls) per frame over the deck's 62 calls with no index; at 62 calls it is trivial and at a streamed station of 174-plus calls across many cells it is not, and nothing gates the cost.
The gate SKIPs rather than fails when there is no built deck, which is the correct shape and means CI (which has no deck) never runs the acceptance test.
